subject.text: My laptop blocks an app I downloaded, is it broken?

description.text: I wanted to install a free PDF editor from the site pdf-gratis-banget.example.
When I opened it a warning appeared: 'Installation blocked. Use the office App Portal.'
Other than that the laptop runs smoothly, email and the Attendance app open fine.
Can you please turn off the block?

history.text: The App Portal (portal.nusadigital.test) already offers an official PDF editor.

explanation: The laptop is healthy; the block is an office rule so apps from random sites can't bring in malware (harmful programs). Guide Maya to install the official PDF editor from the App Portal.
hints: Read the warning. Is it a sign of damage or an office rule?
Office apps are installed from the App Portal, and it already has an official PDF editor.
